extensions.name: PyPiPieShell
extensions.description: Python editor and REPL for Revit built on AvalonEdit: Python highlighting, Revit API autocomplete, signature help and hover, a persistent REPL, transaction modes and Esc to interrupt. Opens as a modal window, a modeless window or a dockable pane, and follows Revit's dark/light theme.
extensions.author: Aaron Rumple
